summary: Comprehensive testing of HSBC bank app with sort code bank lookup feature. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All sort code lookup tests passed successfully. The sort code bank lookup feature works correctly for all tested scenarios including HSBC, Barclays, Lloyds, unrecognized codes, auto-formatting, and field order.

integration_issues.issue: 403 Forbidden error when fetching accounts after direct navigation to transfers screen. This appears to be an auth token issue when navigating directly to the transfers route.

action_items: Investigate 403 error when directly navigating to transfers screen (auth token may not persist across direct route navigation)
Consider adding loading state for account selector on transfers screen
critical_code_review_comments: Sort code bank lookup implementation is excellent - clean separation of concerns with dedicated service file
Bank lookup is pure client-side logic (no API calls) which is correct for this use case
Auto-formatting works perfectly with XX-XX-XX format
Field order is correct: Recipient Name → Sort Code → Account Number
Bank name display UI is well-designed with green success box and orange warning box
All backend APIs working correctly with proper error handling
Default account balances ($5000 checking, $10000 savings) created correctly on registration
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx - Added testID attributes for email, password inputs and login button
/app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx - Added testID attributes for all form inputs and register button
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create unique test users for each run. No manual seed data needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features tested and working. The 403 error on direct navigation to transfers is a minor issue that doesn't affect normal user flow (users would navigate via tabs, not direct URL). Sort code bank lookup feature is fully functional and meets all requirements.
